Fix this bug in the Android app. droid-monkey found it on a device: a bug in normal use.

A negative amount of money is shown
What happens: 'Add ₹-5 more for free delivery' (free_delivery)
On screen: detailscreen
Evidence: Add ₹-5 more for free delivery
Steps from a fresh launch that show it: tap product_1 > tap? android:id/button1|text:nice

Rules:
- Find the root cause in the code and make the smallest correct fix; keep everything else the same.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not commit.
- Call the compile tool ('main') before you finish and fix every error.
- Reply with one short paragraph: the cause and what you changed.

content.text: Found it. For Banana Bunch (₹60 with 10% off = ₹54), `freeDeliveryShortfallPaise()` returns `4900 - 5400 = -500`, so the UI shows "Add ₹-5 more".

content.text: `Product.freeDeliveryShortfallPaise()` computed `FREE_DELIVERY_PAISE - dealPricePaise()` and returned the raw difference, so when the deal price already exceeded the free-delivery threshold (e.g. Banana Bunch at ₹54 vs. ₹49 threshold) the shortfall went negative and the detail screen rendered "Add ₹-5 more for free delivery". I clamped the result with `.coerceAtLeast(0L)` in `app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/ProductRepository.kt:25`, so any price at or above the threshold now returns 0 and the existing `if (shortfall == 0L)` branch shows "Free delivery" instead. Compiled clean.
